title: [ai] Implement interactive 3D visualization for codebase spatial navigation
body:
## Summary

Develop a core interactive 3D interface that visually and spatially represents features, components, APIs, services, and dependencies as physical spaces (rooms, workspaces, doors, etc.) using React Three Fiber.

## Why

The primary product value proposition is an immersive 3D environment that helps developers explore codebases spatially. Without this, the product is not usable or differentiated.

## Scope

- Render 3D models representing architectural entities mapped from the codebase.
- Implement interactive navigation controls (camera movement, selection).
- Integrate basic UI overlays or tooltips for element metadata.

## Suggested acceptance criteria

- User can navigate a 3D representation of a simple sample codebase.
- Rooms (features), workspaces (components), doors (APIs), and hallways (dependencies) are visually distinct.
- Entities show basic metadata on hover or click.
- Navigation uses keyboard and mouse controls fluidly without noticeable lag.
- It is implemented within the existing React and three.js stack.

title: [ai] Develop backend codebase parser to map source files into architectural entities
body:
## Summary

Create a backend service or module using ts-morph to analyze TypeScript/JavaScript codebases and produce structured data representing features, components, APIs, services, and their dependencies.

## Why

Accurate and automated codebase parsing is required to transform source code into spatial 3D model components. Manual mapping would not scale.

## Scope

- Parse input repo and extract features, components, APIs, services, dependencies.
- Output a JSON model suitable for the frontend 3D renderer.
- Handle basic complexity (modules, imports, exports).

## Suggested acceptance criteria

- Given a sample TypeScript project, the parser outputs a JSON mapping all entities with correct hierarchical relationships.
- Includes APIs (functions or endpoints), services (modules), dependencies (imports).
- Has coverage for basic error handling and logs parsing process.
- Unit test coverage for major parser functions above 70%.

title: [ai] Integrate authentication and secure access control for the 3D office
body:
## Summary

Implement user authentication (e.g., via OAuth or JWT) and role-based access control to secure access to the codequarter interface.

## Why

Security is crucial for production readiness to protect codebase data and user information. Unauthorized access risks data leaks.

## Scope

- Add login/logout flows.
- Support roles and permissions (viewer, editor).
- Protect API endpoints and frontend routes accordingly.

## Suggested acceptance criteria

- Users can register/login via a secure method.
- Access to the 3D environment is restricted to authenticated users.
- Unauthorized users get redirected to the login page.
- Role permissions dictate UI features available.
- Includes backend validation of tokens on APIs.
- Security audit of authentication logic completed.

title: [ai] Build automated end-to-end testing suite covering 3D navigation and UI flows
body:
## Summary

Develop comprehensive automated end-to-end tests for critical user flows including 3D navigation, element interaction, and user onboarding.

## Why

Early-stage projects require robust automated tests to prevent regressions and ensure reliability as new features are added.

## Scope

- Use Playwright or Cypress.
- Cover navigation controls, metadata display interaction, login flow.
- Validate visual correctness where feasible.

## Suggested acceptance criteria

- Test suite runs in CI environment and passes reliably.
- Tests cover navigation in 3D office for at least 3 architectural entity types.
- Interaction testing includes hover and click showing metadata.
- Login/logout flows validated with test users.
- Documentation on how to run tests locally and in CI.

title: [ai] Add real-time observability and error reporting in production environment
body:
## Summary

Set up observability tooling including logging, error reporting, and performance monitoring for both frontend and backend in production.

## Why

Monitoring is essential for understanding app health, diagnosing issues, and improving user experience in production.

## Scope

- Integrate Sentry or similar for error tracking.
- Add frontend and backend performance metrics collection.
- Configure alerting and dashboards.

## Suggested acceptance criteria

- Errors and unhandled exceptions are reported automatically.
- Latency and usage metrics are collected and visible on dashboards.
- Production logs include structured data for debugging.
- Alert rules trigger notifications for critical errors.
- Documentation added describing observability setup.

title: [ai] Create developer onboarding documentation with setup, architecture, and usage guides
body:
## Summary

Write comprehensive onboarding documentation to help new developers understand how to set up the repo, grasp overall architecture, and contribute effectively.

## Why

Good documentation accelerates contributor ramp-up time and improves community engagement.

## Scope

- Setup instructions for local development.
- High-level architecture overview describing 3D mappings.
- Coding standards and workflow explanation.
- Instructions for running tests and submitting PRs.

## Suggested acceptance criteria

- README and docs folders include above documentation topics.
- Documentation reviewed and approved by at least two team members.
- Includes example commands for installation, dev server, tests.
- Clear explanation of codebase entities and mappings.

title: [ai] Implement API to serve parsed architectural data to frontend dynamically
body:
## Summary

Develop REST or GraphQL API endpoints that supply the frontend with the parsed codebase structure and metadata needed to render the 3D environment.

## Why

The frontend requires live, dynamic data representing codebase state to enable up-to-date 3D visualization.

## Scope

- Define API schema for architectural entities.
- Serve parsed JSON data on demand.
- Include filtering and pagination if needed.

## Suggested acceptance criteria

- API endpoints return valid JSON conforming to schema.
- Frontend successfully fetches and renders data from API.
- API handles errors gracefully and provides useful error messages.
- Endpoints have basic authentication checks if needed.
- Document API specification.

title: [ai] Optimize frontend performance for rendering complex 3D scenes
body:
## Summary

Improve frontend rendering performance of the 3D scene to ensure smooth interaction on a range of devices and codebase sizes.

## Why

Smooth, low-latency 3D experiences are critical for usability and product success, especially as scene complexity grows.

## Scope

- Profile rendering bottlenecks.
- Implement techniques such as lazy loading, level of detail (LOD), and memoization.
- Optimize React component updates.

## Suggested acceptance criteria

- Frame rate meets or exceeds 60fps on benchmark scenes.
- CPU and GPU usage remain within acceptable thresholds under heavy load.
- Visual fidelity remains intact after optimizations.
- Performance test reports included.

title: [ai] Refine and improve UI/UX for ease of spatial navigation and discovery
body:
## Summary

Enhance the user interface and experience around navigating the 3D office, including controls, UI hints, and spatial audio if feasible.

## Why

A usable and intuitive navigation experience reduces onboarding time and user frustration, improving overall adoption.

## Scope

- Improve navigation controls responsiveness and intuitiveness.
- Add visual cues like minimap, breadcrumbs.
- Implement contextual help and tutorials.

## Suggested acceptance criteria

- Navigation controls tested for ease on keyboard, mouse, gamepad.
- Visual UI elements assist in orientation and discovery.
- Onboarding tutorial walks new users through core navigation and interaction.
- User feedback incorporated from initial usability testing.

title: [ai] Configure robust CI/CD pipelines with automated tests and deployments
body:
## Summary

Enhance existing GitHub Actions workflows to fully automate linting, testing, building, and deploying previews and production releases.

## Why

Reliable automated pipelines reduce manual errors, enforce quality, and consistently deliver new versions.

## Scope

- Add test running steps to CI workflow.
- Ensure preview and production deploy workflows run only after successful tests.
- Add notifications on failures.

## Suggested acceptance criteria

- CI pipeline runs lint, type checks, tests, and builds successfully on PRs.
- Preview deploy triggers on staging branches automatically.
- Production deploy only proceeds on passing CI.
- Failures send notifications via GitHub or Slack.
- Documentation updated reflecting pipelines.

title: [ai] Implement environment configuration and secret management for deployments
body:
## Summary

Establish a standardized approach for managing environment variables and secrets (API keys, tokens) required during development and deployment.

## Why

Proper secret management protects sensitive data and supports consistent deployments across environments.

## Scope

- Define .env files, GitHub secrets, and Vercel environment variables usage.
- Validate secrets presence in CI/CD workflows to skip unsafe deploys.
- Document configuration steps for contributors.

## Suggested acceptance criteria

- Secrets for Vercel and OpenAI API keys are securely stored outside codebase.
- Deploy workflows conditionally run based on secret availability.
- Missing secrets trigger warnings and skips deploys.
- Documentation clearly instructs setup.

title: [ai] Define release process including versioning, changelog, and tagging
body:
## Summary

Create a documented and automated release process that includes semantic versioning, changelog generation, and Git tagging to support structured product deliveries.

## Why

A defined release process is critical for product maturity, traceability, and user communication.

## Scope

- Define versioning scheme (e.g., semver).
- Automate changelog generation from commit messages.
- Automate Git tags and GitHub releases.
- Document process and whom to notify on release.

## Suggested acceptance criteria

- Releases created through the process include accurate changelog.
- Tags follow consistent naming conventions.
- Release automation integrated with CI/CD.
- Documentation guides on creating new releases.
